calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Verdan (the Clay-Born), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Verdan, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Verdan's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
Verdan is androgynous, tall and slender, with pale fired-porcelain skin, a soft oval face, a fine jaw and calm gold-green eyes with a gentle, knowing look. Hair is very long, pale sage-green, falling past the waist in a loose braid over one shoulder. Costume: a long ivory robe with a high collar and wide sleeves tied at the wrists, a long ivory sash wound at the waist, all edged with gold embroidery and a moss-green hem; under it an ivory undertunic and dark moss-olive trousers. Living GOLD CHAINS coil around both forearms and upper arms, with loose links trailing from the free arm and drifting like thread. WEAPON: a lance about one and a half times his height. The shaft is pale celadon glazed clay with fine cracks, wound with a spiral of gold chain links, and loose chain coils at the butt. The blade is a leaf-shaped gold spearhead with a jade-green vein down its centre and a ring of gold chain at the socket. He grips the lance in his RIGHT hand at mid-shaft; his LEFT hand holds the shaft below the blade for thrusts. Energy and trails: GOLD light with jade-green glints; the chains glow gold.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right with the lance held upright; a combat stance with the lance lowered across the hips; a walking pose with the sash and long braid swinging; a running pose with the robe flowing; a jump with the chains trailing; a close-up of the gold leaf blade and the chain-wound shaft
- middle rows: six attack and special poses: two thrusts, a low rising sweep, a lunging charge with a gold trail, a diving plunge, a burst of living chains from the ground
- bottom row: guard with the lance across the body and chains raised, hit reaction, knocked down, a calm victory pose with the lance planted, the signature gold chains binding upward with a jade glow
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
